message.content:
Sure! One of the most popular services that turns an IP address into detailed company‑level data (including contact info when available) is **[ipinfo.io](https://ipinfo.io)**. Below is a quick rundown of how you can use it, along with a sample request/response.

---

## 📌 ipinfo.io – Company Data API

| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Endpoint** | `https://ipinfo.io/<IP>/json` |
| **Authentication** | API key via `Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>` header (or `?token=<TOKEN>` query param) |
| **Response format** | JSON |
| **Free tier** | 50k requests/month, 1 request/sec, limited fields |
| **Paid plans** | Unlimited requests, additional fields (e.g., `company`, `phone`, `email`) |

### 🔑 Getting Started

1. Sign up at [ipinfo.io](https://ipinfo.io/signup) and obtain your API token.
2. Use the token in the `Authorization` header or as a query parameter.

### 🛠️ Example Request

```http
GET https://ipinfo.io/8.8.8.8/json?token=YOUR_TOKEN_HERE
```

Or with the header:

```http
GET https://ipinfo.io/8.8.8.8/json
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE
```

### 📄 Sample Response (JSON)

```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "hostname": "dns.google",
  "city": "Mountain View",
  "region": "California",
  "country": "US",
  "loc": "37.3860,-122.0840",
  "org": "AS15169 Google LLC",
  "postal": "94035",
  "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles",
  "readme": "https://ipinfo.io/missingauth",
  "company": {
    "name": "Google LLC",
    "domain": "google.com",
    "industry": "Internet Services",
    "phone": "+1-650-253-0000",
    "email": "contact@google.com"
  }
}
```

> **Note:** The `company` object appears only on paid plans. In the free tier, you’ll get the `org` field (e.g., `"AS15169 Google LLC"`) but no phone/email.

### ⚙️ Using the API in Python

```python
import requests

def get_company_info(ip_address, token):
    url = f"https://ipinfo.io/{ip_address}/json"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=5)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()

# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    token = "YOUR_TOKEN_HERE"
    ip = "8.8.8.8"
    data = get_company_info(ip, token)
    print(data.get("company", "No company data available"))
```

### 🚀 Alternatives

| Service | Key Features | Free Tier | Paid Plan |
|---------|--------------|-----------|-----------|
| **[ipstack.com](https://ipstack.com)** | Geo + company + phone/email | 10k/month | Unlimited |
| **[ipapi.co](https://ipapi.co)** | Geo + company + phone/email | 30k/month | Unlimited |
| **[ipgeolocation.io](https://ipgeolocation.io)** | Geo + company + phone/email | 30k/month | Unlimited |
| **[ipdata.co](https://ipdata.co)** | Geo + company + phone/email | 25k/month | Unlimited |

All of these services expose similar endpoints (`/json` or `/ip/<IP>`) and require an API key. Pick one based on your quota needs and pricing.
